title: Surreal Oriental Stairway
description: A woman in an ornate orange and red kimono holding a red umbrella ascends a green staircase through sand dunes. Behind her floats a large circular frame containing a dragonfly, chrysanthemum trees, and an aurora-like sky, while a transparent bubble to the right holds a green teddy bear and a rabbit sits on red theater seats.
prompt: A woman in a vibrant orange patterned kimono holding a red paper umbrella climbs a long green staircase that emerges from sand dunes. A massive circular golden frame in the sky contains chrysanthemum trees, a large green dragonfly, and swirling green and orange aurora. To the right, a transparent bubble floats above red theater seats where a rabbit sits, while inside the bubble a green teddy bear stands on sand. Surreal dreamlike composition with falling leaves, detailed and colorful digital painting.
